sections.heading: Achievement progress
sections.body: Achievements track accomplishments across the game. Use category and progress filters to find completed goals or objectives still in progress. Hidden achievements remain concealed until their discovery conditions are met.

sections.heading: Points and Renown
sections.body: Completed achievements contribute the points and Renown shown in the summary. Individual cards display their requirements, progress, and rewards. Progress is recorded by the relevant gameplay system automatically.

sections.heading: Titles
sections.body: Unlocked titles appear in the Title Collection. Select a title to preview it and equip it to your character; equipping a new title replaces the currently equipped one but does not remove either title from your collection.
